title: Bunsen's First Day at Catasory
summary: Bunsen the scientist goes to his new school, Catasory, a welcoming place where kind cats, dragonettes, and scientists study together. Guided by his dragon mother, Helua, Bunsen settles in and discovers that mean cats like Gorp are strictly banned. Throughout the day, under the guidance of teachers like Figaro and Katsumi, Bunsen tackles a variety of lessons. He practices counting various items, categorizes creatures into land, water, air, and underground habitats, and plays a guessing game with ancient fossils like sea urchins, sand dollars, and prehistoric claws.

characters.name: Bunsen
characters.description: An obsessive chronometeorologist who views sleep as a luxury the world cannot afford, they spend their days and sunless nights tethered to a brass-bound "time wind tracker." With eyes bloodshot from perpetual vigilance, they monitor the shifting currents of temporal drafts, sacrificing rest to calibrate their instruments and fortify their laboratory against the encroaching gale of an impending storm.

characters.name: Helua
characters.description: Bunsen's caring dragon mother, a green and red dragon who possesses mold chip, grass, and lava powers.

characters.name: Dimitar
characters.description: A sharp-witted resident of a circular island castle, this two-century-old purple dragonet carries a pirate’s salt-crusted legacy and a fierce devotion to his salvaged library. Formerly of the Cadasori galleries, Seeker’s grumpy companion now roams the deep to save his ancestral shores, though a recent volcanic disturbance has left him uncharacteristically sickened and frail. Driven by habit and a tireless appetite for fish, he bickers incessantly over snacks while guarding his remaining volumes with a brooding, protective intensity.

characters.name: Gorp
characters.description: A cat traveler who journeys to Cat World and discovers his role in the story.

characters.name: Ginger
characters.description: A soft, round, and silver-coated feline, this exceptionally fluffy educator is one of Minnie and Mickey’s own kittens grown into a figure of quiet authority. Known for daintily distributing napkins with velvet paws and commuting to school behind the wheel, the gray-furred teacher balances his role on Nana’s welcoming committee with a life of polite, helpful service. Whether presiding over his humble sanctuary—the very cage Seeker once coveted—or sustaining himself on crunchy kibble and savory wet food, he remains a steady presence, most recently seen trading his classroom duties for the shadows of a secret closet hideout alongside Garfield.

characters.name: Katsumi
characters.description: A distinguished scholar of the Ginger Catasorry and elite member of the academy’s talking cat crew, this feline has emerged from a long dormancy to join Kitty’s cat troop. Balancing studious discipline with silver-tongued eloquence, they bring the full weight of their feline intellect and the rare gift of speech to the unfolding journey.

characters.name: Figaro
characters.description: A sharp-witted scholar of the Ginger Catasorry, this feline hero balances rigorous academic discipline with the street-wise loyalty of Kitty’s superhero troop. Driven by a restless spirit, they are the first to slip into the night in search of adventure, prowling for action while the rest of the crew sleeps.

characters.name: Beaker
characters.description: A high-strung Muppet and devoted companion to Bunsen, this jittery assistant—and close friend to Kitty—communicates solely through a frantic cadence of staccato "meeps" and "me-me" sounds. Driven by a nervous obsession with their work, they share a home with the scientist, remaining perpetually wide-eyed and sleepless until the day’s experiments reach a successful conclusion, pausing only for the occasional, coveted treat from the local bakery.

characters.name: Amoosu
characters.description: A fire dragon who is part of the school community.

characters.name: The Floofers
characters.description: Tiny, pom-pom-like, and irrepressibly bouncy, these magical ball-shaped denizens of the Floofer Clouds leap with wide-eyed grace across resilient, vaporous peaks. Sustained by a vital dependency on floof-berries, these restless creatures possess a staggering verticality and a vibrant energy so potent that falling asleep remains an elusive feat.

characters.name: The Mookers
characters.description: Hailing from a neighboring planet, these toe-sized spheres of dense fur bear the uncanny features of miniature moose. They communicate through a rhythmic chorus of "mooks" and are defined by a singular, voracious obsession with sandwiches.

places.name: Catasory
places.description: A bustling, friendly school where scientists, dragonettes, cats, and other unique creatures learn together.
